facts.fact: Modern CTV platforms let businesses launch campaigns with as little as $50, according to the page.
facts.quote: This approach allows businesses to launch campaigns with as little as $50, using automatic pacing algorithms to intelligently distribute the budget over the campaign's duration

facts.fact: The page recommends allocating a test budget of around $500 to $2,000 to gather enough impression data before making informed decisions.
facts.quote: allocate a test budget of around $500 to $2,000 to gather enough impression data to make informed decisions

facts.fact: The page recommends defining a geographic targeting radius of typically 5 to 15 miles around a business's physical location for programmatic CTV.
facts.quote: define a tight geographic radius around your physical location, typically between 5 and 15 miles

facts.fact: The page recommends running two or three different creative variations before increasing CTV spending.
facts.quote: Run two or three different creative variations to see which message performs best before increasing your spending

facts.fact: The page advises monitoring CTV campaign performance weekly and pausing ads that do not meet KPIs such as cost-per-lead.
facts.quote: It’s important to monitor performance weekly, pausing any ads that aren't meeting your key performance indicators (KPIs), such as cost-per-lead.

facts.fact: The page states that AI-powered production platforms can automatically generate broadcast-quality video ads from simple inputs such as a website URL.
facts.quote: AI-powered production platforms are changing that by automatically generating broadcast-quality video ads from simple inputs like a website URL.

facts.fact: The page describes programmatic CTV as using real-time bidding to place ads on premium streaming channels.
facts.quote: This method uses real-time bidding to place ads on premium streaming channels while maintaining control over who sees the ad and how much is spent.

facts.fact: The page says traditional TV advertising often required high minimum spend commitments that were out of reach for most small businesses.
facts.quote: often with high minimum spend commitments that placed it out of reach for most small businesses

facts.fact: The page recommends aligning CTV campaign timing with peak seasonal demand, such as promoting HVAC services in spring or tax services in the first quarter.
facts.quote: It is important to align campaign timing with peak seasonal demand in your industry, such as promoting HVAC services in the spring or tax services in the first quarter.

facts.fact: The page recommends setting up conversion tracking and campaign-tagged links before a CTV launch, and a dedicated tracking number for phone inquiries.
facts.quote: Set up conversion tracking and campaign-tagged links before launch. For phone inquiries, consider a dedicated tracking number.

facts.fact: The page states that performance-based CTV uses cross-device tracking, location data, and conversion pixels to link TV ad exposure to customer actions.
facts.quote: By using cross-device tracking, location data, and conversion pixels, these campaigns directly link TV ad exposure to customer actions.

facts.fact: The page presents the article as a guide to 10 CTV advertising examples and strategies for 2026, published February 21, 2026.
facts.quote: 10 Powerful CTV Advertising Examples and Strategies to Copy in 2026

facts.fact: The page recommends allocating around 60-70% of a CTV campaign budget to CTV for broad awareness.
facts.quote: allocate the majority of your budget (around 60-70%) to CTV for broad awareness and the remaining 30-40% to digital channels for conversion.

facts.fact: The page advises planning a CTV calendar 3 to 6 months in advance.
facts.quote: Plan your CTV calendar 3 to 6 months in advance by mapping out your industry’s peak seasons.

facts.fact: The page gives an example of a campaign goal of increasing online orders by 15%.
facts.quote: Don't just aim for "brand awareness"; aim to increase online orders by 15% or drive 50 new appointment bookings.
